content: Checkpoint commands preserve exact-scope staging, path and symlink safety, race detection, failure cleanup, deterministic replay, and read-only inspection.
Admission is mechanically enforced before every earliest execution side effect and returns machine-readable refusal evidence.
Durable progress is versioned, reconstructible, same-attempt resumable, and does not replay completed non-idempotent work.
Retry identity and bounds are explicit; failure transitions to evidence-backed blocked instead of leaving an abandoned working attempt.
Lifecycle statuses and Human approval boundaries are unchanged, and no out-of-scope integration or publication action occurred.
Focused tests, regressions, plugin validation, diff scope, and documentation agree with the source Intake.
